name: Email & Messages
description: Электронные письма: приветствия, вежливые формулировки, подпись

entries.word: Dear Sir or Madam,
entries.translation: Уважаемый господин или госпожа (официальное начало письма),

entries.word: Dear Mr. Johnson,
Dear Ms. Parker,
Hi John,
Hello team,
Good afternoon, colleagues.
I am writing to inquire about…
I am writing regarding your recent order.
entries.translation: Пишу по поводу вашего недавнего заказа.

entries.word: With reference to our conversation…
Further to my previous email…
entries.translation: В дополнение к моему предыдущему письму...

entries.word: As discussed, I am sending you the files.
Please find attached the report.
Attached you will find the invoice.
I have attached my resume for your review.
Could you please confirm receipt of this message?
entries.translation: Не могли бы вы подтвердить получение этого сообщения?

entries.word: I would appreciate a prompt reply.
Looking forward to hearing from you.
Awaiting your feedback.
Please respond at your earliest convenience.
No rush — whenever you get a chance.
Just a quick reminder about tomorrow’s meeting.
This is a gentle nudge about the pending payment.
Apologies for the late reply.
Sorry for the delayed response, I was on vacation.
entries.translation: Извините за задержку с ответом, я был в отпуске.

entries.word: Thanks for getting back to me.
Thank you for your quick reply.
I appreciate your help with this matter.
entries.translation: Ценю вашу помощь в этом вопросе.

entries.word: Unfortunately, we cannot accept the offer.
entries.translation: К сожалению, мы не можем принять предложение.

entries.word: Regretfully, I must decline.
We regret to inform you that…
Please keep me informed of any changes.
Let me know if anything is unclear.
Feel free to reach out if you have questions.
Don’t hesitate to contact me.
If you have any questions, just ask.
Could you resend the file? It didn’t open.
entries.translation: Могли бы вы прислать файл заново? Он не открылся.

entries.word: I might have misunderstood — could you clarify?
entries.translation: Возможно, я неправильно понял — могли бы уточнить?

entries.word: Just to confirm: the meeting is at three, right?
entries.translation: Чтобы уточнить: встреча в три, верно?

entries.word: CC’ing Anna for visibility.
entries.translation: Ставлю Анну в копию для информации.

entries.word: Moving this thread offline.

Kind regards,
